description: Cathie Wood is betting that we’re only at the beginning of a technological transformation decades in the making. The ARK Invest founder & CEO joins us to unpack why AI is accelerating faster than expected, how robotaxis and humanoid robots could reshape the physical world, and why healthcare may be one of the market’s most overlooked AI opportunities. Plus, Cathie shares her latest thinking on Bitcoin, crypto, managing risk after ARK’s wild pandemic-era ride and the companies she believes could…
classificationReason: Robotics is a substantial part of a technology-investing discussion, including robotaxis and humanoid robots.
qualityReason: Detailed interview with timestamps and focused analysis from an identified industry investor.
